summary: The authors have addressed the prior required revisions from the terminal review: the manuscript now uses conventional numbered IEEE citations with verified bibliographic metadata, the Methods include a clear provider-call accounting clarification (stage_counts authoritative vs condition_counts annotation) citing deterministic_reconciliation.json, and the Disclosure Statement concisely lists adapter, task generator, verifier, analysis executor and preserves the immutable master-prompt locator and SHA-256. The preregistered design, shared_initial_candidate semantics, execution accounting, deterministic verifier oracle, and paired analysis are thoroughly documented and artifact-backed. No unresolved critical issues remain.
optional_revisions: (Optional) Add the one-sentence pointer in Methods clarifying the exact McNemar two-sided p-value convention for very small discordant counts and refer readers to analysis/analysis_log.jsonl for the implementation detail (this was already suggested in the previous review).

(Optional) Add a brief audit pointer (one short sentence or boxed pointer) mapping key archived artifact filenames to the principal reported numbers (e.g., execution/raw_results.jsonl → contingency counts; execution/model_configuration.json → declared model and temperature=null; analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv → n11/n10/n01/n00) to aid rapid external audit.

(Optional) Consider one short clarifying paragraph (≤4–5 sentences) in Discussion contrasting the repair-only estimand under shared_initial_candidate semantics with alternative guarded contrasts that permit independent first-pass guarded generations, to help readers interpret the scope of the measured effect.
